items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I worked the Stan Getz quartet, Dizzy Gillespie small band, Cannonball’s and Nat’s, and a lot of stuff.

ctx.x: Did you find yourself saying that?

Yeah, of course. I’m just like everybody else. I have to try to stay there to produce something, to get a little jive gig. That’s what everybody did. So you get a chance to play with almost anybody. I worked the Stan Getz quartet, Dizzy Gillespie small band, Cannonball’s and Nat’s, and a lot of stuff.
